sec: sec:C009: Enable real-time feedback and intervention / Control mays

blocks.id: blk:C009: Enable real-time feedback and intervention / Control mays/1
blocks.text: Reviewing user feedback and intervention logs at regular intervals, analyzing findings using structured methodologies (e.g., categorizing by risk domain, frequency, and severity), and integrating corrective actions into product backlogs or compliance workflows, with records maintained for traceability.
